answer: Locks are recorded in willow, expire in thread, and falcon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 182 aliases thus needs 177 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 879 identities would post 3692 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
